description:
Crown Circus is one of the West End's best-known terraces and this well-presented two-bedroom lower ground floor conversion offers comfortable accommodation, a private main door entrance, private outdoor space and direct access to a shared garden, all within the leafy surroundings of Dowanhill.

Designed by James Thomson between 1857 and 1860, Crown Circus is the only semi-circular terrace within Dowanhill and remains one of the area's most distinctive addresses. The terrace is formed around attractive central gardens and is notable for its blonde sandstone frontage, cast iron railings and mature trees. Between 2005 and 2009, the buildings underwent an extensive programme of restoration and upgrading, helping preserve the character and appearance of this important period terrace.

The property is accessed through a private main door entrance, reached via a short flight of steps. To the front there is a private terrace which provides space for outdoor seating, while to the rear residents enjoy direct access to a well-maintained shared garden with lawn and mature planting.

As the photographs and floorplan demonstrate, the property offers bright, comfortable accommodation that has been thoughtfully upgraded. Notable features include an Ashley Ann kitchen fitted with Siemens appliances, Pergo engineered flooring and a cast iron wood-burning stove positioned on a slate hearth within the main living room.

The accommodation extends to a reception hallway, broad living room with ample space for dining, fitted kitchen, two double bedrooms, principal en-suite bathroom and a separate shower room.

Attributes

Iconic Crown Circus address in Dowanhill
Main door lower ground floor conversion
Private front terrace
Direct access to shared rear garden
Broad living room with dining space
Ashley Ann kitchen with Siemens appliances
Two double bedrooms
Principal en-suite bathroom
Separate shower room

Convenient for Byres Road, Glasgow University and excellent transport links
